title: Policies on the Agenda Are Almost All Deficit-Increasing
units: Increase in the primary deficit, percent of GDP
source: Congressional Budget Office; Joint Committee on Taxation; Yale Budget Lab; author's calculations.
note: Relative to CBO's February 2026 baseline; excludes added debt service. The tariff estimate is what was reflected in that baseline; actual collections under the current regime appear closer to about 0.3 percent of GDP. Plausible outcomes is the author's judgment of the likely combination.

data.label: Keep defense constant as a share of GDP
